![Battlenet 2021 icon.svg](/images/Battlenet_2021_icon.svg?70eff1)   *For the Battle.net web API, see [https://community.developer.battle.net/documentation/world-of-warcraft](https://community.developer.battle.net/documentation/world-of-warcraft)*.

[![World of Warcraft](/images/WoW_Icon_update.png?d4be1e)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft "World of Warcraft") *For a comparison of Classic API, see [World of Warcraft API/Classic](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/World_of_Warcraft_API/Classic "World of Warcraft API/Classic")*. *For an alphabetically ordered list, see [Global functions](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Global_functions "Global functions")*.

The **WoW API** is used by Blizzard's [Lua](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Lua "Lua") user interface and available to [AddOns](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/AddOn "AddOn") and [macro scripts](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/MACRO_script "MACRO script"). It's officially documented in [Blizzard_APIDocumentation](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/tree/live/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_APIDocumentationGenerated) which is accessible via the [/api](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/APILink "APILink") command. The [FrameXML](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/FrameXML "FrameXML") UI code can be [exported](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Viewing_Blizzard%27s_interface_code "Viewing Blizzard's interface code") from the game client.

[![Note](/images/Icon-information-22x22.png?81245f)](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Icon-information-22x22.png "Note")

**Note:** This page is up to date as of PTR [Patch 12.1.5](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_12.1.5/API_changes "Patch 12.1.5/API changes") (69594) Aug 28 2026

[Glyphs](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Glyph "Glyph") were added in [Patch 3.0.2](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_3.0.2 "Patch 3.0.2"). After the Glyph interface was removed in [Patch 7.0.3](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_7.0.3 "Patch 7.0.3") they were streamlined into the [Spellbook](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Spellbook "Spellbook").

## Group Finder

The Looking For Group tool was added in [Patch 2.0.1](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_2.0.1 "Patch 2.0.1"). It was renamed to the [Dungeon Finder](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Dungeon_Finder "Dungeon Finder") in [Patch 3.3.0](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_3.3.0 "Patch 3.3.0") and raid queuing moved to a separate [Raid Browser](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Raid_Browser "Raid Browser"). The [Raid Finder](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Raid_Finder "Raid Finder") was added in [Patch 4.3.0](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_4.3.0 "Patch 4.3.0") and merged into the Dungeon Finder in [Patch 5.0.4](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_5.0.4 "Patch 5.0.4"). The Dungeon Finder was reworked in [Patch 6.0.2](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_6.0.2 "Patch 6.0.2") into the [Group Finder](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Group_Finder "Group Finder").
